description: This file defines the InterpolatorFragment class for an Android application, demonstrating animation interpolators and path animations using ObjectAnimator to animate view scaling along specified paths.

classes.name: InterpolatorFragment
classes.description: A Fragment demonstrating the use of different animation interpolators and path-based animations in Android.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes views, populates interpolators and paths, sets up event listeners for UI controls.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts an ObjectAnimator to animate the scale of a view along a specified path using a chosen interpolator.

methods.name: getInterpolators
methods.description: Returns the array of interpolators used in the fragment.

methods.name: getPathIn
methods.description: Returns the Path object used for the 'in' (shrinking) animation.

methods.name: getPathOut
methods.description: Returns the Path object used for the 'out' (growing) animation.
